name: Snake Simulator
desc:
👍 LIKE and JOIN the group to get +1,000 starting size! 👍

🔴 Welcome to Snake Simulator! Eat up smaller blobs to become big and eat other slither snakes to become the biggest in the server! Top the leaderboards, earn EPIC skins and more! 🔴

Have fun, and thanks for playing! If you enjoyed, don't forget to 👍 Like, ⭐ Favorite and 🔔 Follow!
